about: The decision the Platform must return for each payload. tests/integration/test_contract_fixtures.py sends every payload, byte for byte, through the real device route and checks it; it never rewrites this file. after: payloads sent first to the same fresh device, each of them accepted. cursor: the event batch 409 body's last_batch_sequence and last_event_seq.

events/v1/invalid/batch_id_upper_case.js.note: batch_id is a lower-case canonical UUID

events/v1/invalid/body_too_large.json.note: Above 16 KiB as sent: the request boundary refuses it

events/v1/invalid/canonical_too_large.js.note: Fits in 16 KiB as sent, not in canonical form (microsecond times, explicit nulls)

events/v1/invalid/command_line_field.jso.note: No command line in an event

events/v1/invalid/duplicate_key.json.note: A repeated key is invalid JSON at the request boundary

events/v1/invalid/error_code_with_starte.note: error_code only with lost or failed

events/v1/invalid/event_seq_not_after_cu.error: Event sequence does not follow the last accepted event
events/v1/invalid/event_seq_not_after_cu.note: The first event_seq must be above the last accepted one

events/v1/invalid/event_seq_not_increasi.note: event_seq strictly increases inside a batch

events/v1/invalid/event_too_large.json.note: The stored jsonb text of one event is at most 4096 bytes

events/v1/invalid/same_sequence_other_co.error: Event batch identity or sequence conflicts with current state
events/v1/invalid/same_sequence_other_co.note: The last accepted batch_sequence with another batch_id

events/v1/invalid/schema_version_bool.js.note: A bool is not a schema_version

events/v1/invalid/short_image_with_separ.note: process_stopped.image is a short name, never a path

events/v1/invalid/stale_batch_sequence.j.note: A batch_sequence below the last accepted one

events/v1/invalid/too_many_nodes.json.note: More than 2048 JSON nodes: the boundary's structure budget

events/v1/invalid/trust_claim.json.note: A batch cannot carry a trust claim

events/v1/invalid/unknown_envelope_field.note: The body carries no identity field (extra=forbid)

events/v1/invalid/unmasked_user_folder.j.note: The folder after Users must be masked as *

events/v1/invalid/v2_kind_in_v1.json.note: A batch is homogeneous: no v2 kind in a v1 batch

events/v1/invalid/zero_width_in_image.js.note: Unicode Cc/Cf characters (here U+200B) are refused in event text

events/v1/valid/largest_event_seq.json.note: event_seq up to 2^53-1, the console's safe-integer limit

events/v1/valid/mixed_batch.json.note: A first batch may start at any batch_sequence and event_seq; gaps in event_seq are allowed; a short fraction is normalized to microseconds

events/v1/valid/sensor_state.json.note: sensor_state: every state; an error code only with lost or failed
